Name: Uriah the Priest
Summary: Uriah the priest was one of the two faithful witnesses Isaiah took when he wrote the prophecy of Maher-shalal-hash-baz on a great roll. He is a different man from Urijah the prophet of Jeremiah's day.
KeyStory: Isaiah took Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah as faithful witnesses to the written prophecy.
LifeLesson: God's word is given with witnesses, so that no one can later say it was never spoken.
